about_the_game:
Tabletop Tumult – Defend the Castle in a Unique Asymmetric Co-op Adventure!

Welcome to the world of Tabletop Tumult, an innovative VR co-op game that blends strategy and action seamlessly! Your mission? Defend a medieval castle from waves of enemies and climb the leaderboard – together with your teammate.

Experience asymmetric gameplay where the VR player takes charge of the battlefield, gathers resources, and builds defenses, while the PC player fights enemies head-on, strategically eliminates threats, and supports the team. After each enemy wave, you’ll select new upgrades to become stronger and prepare for the next challenge!

Features:

  • Asymmetric Co-op Gameplay: Team up with a partner – whether they’re in VR or on PC.

  • Strategy Meets Action: Build defenses, fight with sword and bow, and adapt your tactics to succeed.

  • Upgrades and Customization: Collect resources, enhance your skills, and fine-tune your strategy.

  • Challenging Difficulty: Face escalating enemy waves, culminating in epic boss battles.

  • Accessible for Everyone: Perfect for seasoned gamers and newcomers alike – thanks to the interactive tutorial and distinct roles.

Join the challenge and face the ultimate waves of enemies with your teammate! Tabletop Tumult delivers an unforgettable and immersive gaming experience.
